The three named systems loops link directly to their case studies, giving the path / -> /about -> project. The 375px and 1280px method screenshots show legible, unclipped text. The mobile homepage shows a Menu button; its expanded interaction was not independently exercised.

evidence.interface: The maintained storefront joins discovery, editorial content, and commerce. The case study describes incremental implementation rather than an isolated redesign.
evidence.social_use_and_learning: The operating specimen moves from a customer or team question to a scoped requirement, incremental release, inspection of the customer path, and review of operational or analytical signals with stakeholders.

The storefront capture is dated July 2026 while Jamie's listed role is 2009-2015; I do not treat that capture as independent proof that every current storefront feature was Jamie's work.

CLM-SUNDAY-DINNER-INVITATION-OPERATIONS-2025 permits workflow-schema projection; CLM-SUNDAY-DINNER-300-PLUS-CORROBORATION preserves aggregate and data-quality limits. Repeated social use is shown; formal moderated user research is not claimed.

Richard Caceres and wider contributors retain credit. Technical Operations connects concrete operating questions to project evidence and names its remaining proof limits. The lab provides a specific correction loop, changing CallNYC's date from 2014-2015 to 2016 across public surfaces, while its proposed team pilot remains prospective.

Open House is bounded public historical lineage supported by the Good Times source record, with collective governance retained. No protected UCSC evaluation text, grades, faculty testimonial, or current Max/Jitter proficiency claim appears in the reviewed public text. About explicitly rejects structural-equivalence inference and separates historical implementation from current technical proficiency. The lab labels its architecture and proposed pilot as developing research/method, not production SaaS, client adoption, peer-reviewed research, or automated trust. Its Maven certificate is bounded professional development. WOW List distinguishes the 2017 production snapshot from its limited 2026 return threshold; CallNYC preserves historical and unofficial status.

Private coalition records, participant-level histories, raw correspondence, educational evaluations, credentials, and private source locators were not exposed in the reviewed public content. Jamie's phone number was not observed in the supplied website text.
Public social responses, recovered interactions, and historical scale are explicitly distinguished from attendance, unique reach, endorsement, and causal policy impact.
The current public-safe project surfaces include historical work. This score does not assert that the historical products are currently operating or that a formal user study occurred.
